name: Euphoria | 28g Prepackaged Flower Special Reserve | Orange Chicken
description:
Orange Chicken – Euphoria Special Reserve - Balance
Top Terpenes – Myrcene, Limonene, Caryophyllene
Hybrid Strain, Crossed between Orange Cookie Chem x Puppy Breath
Aroma & Flavor: Funky citrus and orange notes with pine or herbal undertones.
Euphoric and mood-boosting, creative or talkative and focused yet relaxed effects. 

Euphoria Special Reserve: Ultra-Premium, Redefined
Step beyond the ordinary with Euphoria Special Reserve—the ultimate expression of potency, purity, and precision. Each strain in the Special Reserve collection is chosen for its exceptional cannabinoid and terpene profile, delivering an elevated experience that defines ultra-premium cannabis.
Expertly cultivated, perfectly cured, and packaged for freshness, Euphoria Special Reserve captures the highest tier of quality from our grow. Expect deeper flavor, richer aroma, and a euphoric effect that sets a new standard for connoisseurs.
Euphoria Special Reserve — crafted for those who expect more.
